findings.title: Preserve consequential history independently of bounded display logs
findings.current_player_behavior: The current chronicle/log/relationship/event/transition views have explicit bounded histories. Claims, relationship cause receipts, current facts and situation receipts already preserve specific important state. Pruning a display does not undo that state. However, a future long campaign cannot rely on the last 32 transitions/100 events as its only evidence of an old branch, handoff, source acquisition or an intervened cause chain.

If a summary or ancestry locator is absent, report unknown rather than fabricate past activity.
